note: people_id to VoteApp candidate id for West Virginia. One file covers BOTH sessions in scope, the 2025 Regular Session (LegiScan 2196) and the 2026 Regular Session (2254), because LegiScan people_ids are stable across sessions: 128 of the 134 members appear in both files with the same name, seat and role, and the two resolve runs proposed the same candidate for every person they both matched, with no conflict. The union is 140 people. Six members left after 2025 and six arrived for 2026, and Trenton Barnhart moved from HD-009 to SD-003 between the two sessions, which is why his seat agrees in 2254 but not in 2196. Fifteen entries were added by hand: West Virginia's roster records legal names while the ballot uses nicknames, so the proposer, which matches on the legal first name, could not reach them. Every hand-added entry is corroborated by the district AND by the dataset's own first_name and nickname fields. Entries with a null candidate_id are deliberate: that member is not on the November 2026 ballot, because the seat is not up, or the member is not seeking re-election, or the member lost the May 2026 primary.
